To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the failure of mobile payment platforms is mainly due to the lack of collaboration between all the involved actors, the absence of a common technology standard, and the lack of value-added compared to existing payment methods.

the failure of a mobile payment platform can be explained by a lack of collaboration between its stakeholders, no technology standards, and a low value-added for both consumers and merchants compared with existing payment solutions.
the success of mobile payment platforms is a function of: (1) a collaborative approach between all stakeholders, (2) an interoperable technical platform, and (3) a value-added for all stakeholders.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the failure of mobile payment platforms, which are the most promising payment systems of the future.
the factors explaining the failure and success of mobile payment platforms and the way these factors interact with each other.
a multi-level approach to explain the failure of mobile payments.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
mobile payment platforms need to be more collaborative, more standardized, and more value-added for all the stakeholders.
the success of mobile payment platforms depends on the collaboration between stakeholders, the existence of technology standards, and the creation of a real value for all stakeholders.
mobile payment platforms fail when there is no collaboration between the stakeholders (e.g., banks, mobile operators, retailers, and consumers) and no technology standard.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
mobile payment platforms fail when the value for the stakeholders is not clear, and the technology is not ready.
mobile payment platforms fail because they lack a clear and common vision, and a clear value proposition.
the mobile payment platform is not a technology issue, but an organizational issue.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the failure of mobile payment platforms is not due to a single factor but rather to a combination of different factors.
a better understanding of the reasons for failure of past mobile platforms can help the industry to avoid repeating these errors in the future.
a successful mobile payment platform should be able to provide a value-added for all stakeholders.
